Our Story

A Setu between communities
and reliable health.

HealthSetu began with a simple idea to connect people with the knowledge and resources they need for a healthier life. In today's fast-moving world, health and hygiene often take a backseat. And myths spread easily.

We wanted to build a bridge, a Setu, between communities and reliable health awareness. From small conversations about wellness to launching campaigns for hygiene education.

Our journey is just beginning. We aim to grow a community that spreads wellness, positivity, and care across our community.

Our Mission

To raise awareness about health, hygiene and wellness empowering individuals and communities to lead healthier lives.

Our Vision

A world where everyone has access to the information and tools needed to live a healthy, balanced and happy life.

"We dream of communities that are informed, proactive and united in promoting wellness for all."

Health Education

Our Workshops

Taking health awareness directly into classrooms, one school, one conversation at a time.

📸 Khemanand English Medium School, Jamkhed · 13 June 2026

✦ Workshop 01 · The Beginning

Health Awareness Workshop at Khemanand English Medium School

The very first HealthSetu workshop marked the beginning of our journey to make health education more accessible for students. The session focused on helping students understand the importance of taking care of both their physical and mental well-being through simple, everyday habits.

📍 Location
Jamkhed, Maharashtra
📅 Date
13 June 2026
👥 Participants
30 Students (Classes 9 & 10)
🎯 Focus
Hygiene & Mental Health
🧼 Basic Hygiene ❤️ Importance of Health for Students 🧠 Mental Health & Stress Awareness
  • Conducted HealthSetu's first-ever school awareness session.
  • Around 30 girls from Classes 9 and 10 participated.
  • Students engaged in discussions and shared their thoughts during the session.
  • Created an open environment where students could learn and interact comfortably.
Our Reflection: Every journey begins with a first step, and this workshop was ours. It wasn't perfect, and that's okay. We learned that every workshop is different: some students participate more than others, and every session teaches us something new. That first session gave us the confidence to keep moving forward, and it became the foundation of everything HealthSetu is building today.

📸 Z.P. School, Kusadgaon · 29 June 2026

✦ Workshop 02

Healthy Habits Awareness Workshop at Z.P. School, Kusadgaon

HealthSetu conducted an interactive health awareness workshop for nearly 100 students from Classes 1 to 7. Rather than delivering a traditional lecture, the session was designed as a conversation, encouraging students to participate, share their ideas, and learn through fun activities. The enthusiasm and curiosity of the students made the workshop energetic, engaging, and memorable for everyone involved.

📍 Location
Kusadgaon, Maharashtra
📅 Date
29 June 2026
👥 Participants
~100 Students (Classes 1–7)
🎯 Format
Interactive & Activity-Based
🧼 Personal Hygiene 🥗 Healthy vs. Unhealthy Food 🏃 Exercise & Outdoor Play 😴 Healthy Sleep Habits 📱 Balanced Mobile Phone Use

Interactive activities kept the session lively: students came up front to share what they learned, answered questions with a "Clap Challenge," and took part in open Q&A discussions and conversations about their own experiences.

  • Nearly 100 students from Classes 1–7 participated.
  • Students remained highly energetic and actively engaged throughout the session.
  • Conducted in a conversational, activity-based format rather than a lecture.
  • The interactive approach created a fun and comfortable learning environment.
HealthSetu Reflection: This workshop reminded us that children learn best when they are involved. One of our biggest takeaways was that health education becomes much more meaningful when students feel like they are part of the conversation rather than just an audience. That energy and curiosity is exactly what HealthSetu hopes to bring to every classroom.

📸 Z.P. School, Kusadgaon · 29 June 2026 · tap a photo to enlarge

✦ Workshop 02 · Session 2

Menstrual Health & Personal Safety Awareness

As part of the same school visit, HealthSetu also conducted a dedicated awareness session for girls from Classes 6 and 7. The aim was simple: to create a safe and respectful space where girls could learn about menstruation, menstrual hygiene, nutrition, and personal safety without fear or embarrassment. Two teachers were present throughout the session, supporting and encouraging the discussion.

📍 Location
Kusadgaon, Maharashtra
📅 Date
29 June 2026
👥 Participants
~20 Girls (Classes 6 & 7)
🎯 Focus
Menstrual Health & Safety
🩸 Understanding Menstruation 🌸 Why Do Periods Happen? 🧼 Menstrual Hygiene & Sanitary Products 💙 Breaking the Stigma Around Periods 🛡️ Good Touch & Bad Touch

What we observed: When the session began, the room was very quiet. Many girls looked down, some smiled nervously, and very few made eye contact. It was clear that talking about menstruation wasn't something they were used to doing openly. As the discussion continued, a few girls slowly became more comfortable and started asking questions. Not everyone spoke, and that's okay. Building trust and confidence takes time, especially when these conversations haven't been part of everyday life.

Why this session matters: In many communities, topics like menstruation are still discussed very privately, which can make girls hesitant to ask questions or seek information. HealthSetu believes every girl deserves access to accurate health education and a safe environment where she can learn without feeling embarrassed or judged.

HealthSetu Reflection: This session reminded us that awareness isn't about making everyone speak immediately. Sometimes, success is creating a space where even one girl feels comfortable asking a question she was afraid to ask before. Real change doesn't happen in a single workshop. It begins with small conversations, trust, and showing up consistently.
